ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous mask covering the central and interior fluke lobes. High-intensity geometric region located at the distal-superior margin of the left lobe. Extensive distribution of high-intensity linear pixel strings (1-4 pixels wide) across the central-ventral plane of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 68 degrees and a narrow vertex depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged irregularity and amplitude variation noted on the distal third of the right lobe edge compared to the smoother left lobe profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a smooth upward sweep; trailing edges exhibit a bi-concave trajectory originating from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groupings located exclusively at the extreme distal tip of the right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation, predominantly oriented vertically and diagonally across the mid-section of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical fragmentation and jagged loss of edge integrity at the distal extremity of the right lobe, appearing as an irregular, non-linear termination compared to the left lobe tip.
